g.text: Concurrency and batching: all four request categories

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52677c

g.text: SQ8 flat search | 3M x 512D | Top10 | 3 nodes x 3 vCPUs | 1 compute CPU + 2 support CPUs per node

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #152b43

g.text: B1: concurrency sweep / successful HTTP requests per second

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #152b43

g.text: C4: explicit-batch sweep / validated queries per second (not HTTP requests/s)

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52677c

g.text: B64 diamonds: separate V45.1 admission-remediation follow-up, 640 MiB queue cap. Native B64 baseline reused, not rerun.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52677c

g.text: Other points: primary V45 campaign. Every displayed measurement passed with zero request failures and ordered Top10 IDs matching FP32.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52677c

g.text: B = queries/request; C = in-flight HTTP requests. At B1, query/s = HTTP RPS. For a batch, query/s = B x HTTP RPS.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52677c

g.text: Discrete settings use categorical spacing; lines guide the eye. 60 s dispatch + drain. Finite observations, not maximum capacity or long-run stability.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52677c

g.text: Different support-stage placement; unmatched compiler flags. Sources: primary matrix + admission-remediation JSON (2026-11-09).
